captions.detailed: A binocular astronomy telescope mounted on a single-arm yoke and tripod. The instrument features two parallel, light-grey optical tubes with dark blue objective lenses and black eyepieces at the rear. These tubes are mounted side-by-side on a horizontal crossbar. The crossbar connects to a vertical yoke arm via an altitude pivot, allowing up-and-down tilting. This yoke arm is supported by a dark grey central hub that rotates continuously on a tripod base with three thin black legs.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a binocular astronomy instrument on a tripod. It should feature twin parallel optical tubes on a horizontal cradle, an altitude joint connecting the cradle to a single-arm yoke, and an azimuth joint connecting the yoke to a tripod base with three legs. Use light grey for the tubes, dark blue for the lenses, and dark grey or black for the mount and tripod.
captions.factory: Construct the tripod base using cylinders for the central column and angled cylinders/lines for the three legs. Build the rotating yoke base using a series of stacked cylinders and a vertical rectangular prism for the single arm. Model the cradle using a horizontal cylinder, and the binocular tubes using parallel cylinders with nested concentric cylinders of differing colors for the lenses, eyepieces, and mounting rings. Define a continuous azimuth joint between the tripod and the yoke, and a revolute altitude joint between the yoke arm and the horizontal cradle bar.
